lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Hello again! It is me, Barnaby. I love <color=red>dinosaurs</color>!

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: I have three <color=red>riddles</color> for you. Get them right, and three new books go to the library!

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Riddle 1: I am very big. I have sharp <color=red>teeth</color> and tiny arms. What am I?
lines.hint: Not quite. Which one is very big, with sharp teeth?
lines.correctText: Yes! I am a T. rex. Roar!

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Riddle 2: I am hard and <color=red>round</color>. A baby dinosaur comes out of me. What am I?
lines.hint: Not quite. What do baby dinosaurs come out of?
lines.correctText: That is right! I am an egg.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Riddle 3: I am a very old dinosaur <color=red>bone</color>. I turned into stone. What am I?
lines.hint: Not quite. Which one is an old bone made of stone?
lines.correctText: Well done! I am a fossil.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: You got all three! Three new <color=red>books</color> are going to the library. Now, where is my hat?

afterLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
afterLines.text: I still think about <color=red>dinosaurs</color> on my walks. Roar!
